no-restricted-syntax.message: Off-scale font size. Use a design token: text-caption, text-label, text-body, text-body-lg, text-h3, text-h2, text-h1, text-display. Stock Tailwind sizes do not move when the scale is re-pitched, so a page using them silently stays small.
Off-scale font size in a template literal. Use a design token: text-caption, text-label, text-body, text-body-lg, text-h3, text-h2, text-h1, text-display.
text-muted-foreground is from a shadcn theme this app does not use, so it resolves to nothing. Use text-ink-muted.

Raw Tailwind palette colour. Colour must carry meaning here: use positive, warning, negative, live or accent, or a surface token (surface, panel, ink, subtle). A literal hue does not change with the theme and reads the same in dark mode.
Raw Tailwind palette colour in a template literal. Use positive, warning, negative, live, accent, or a surface token.

A .pos-badge tints its own ground with 12% of currentColor, so the plain semantic hue ends up sitting on itself: measured, text-positive is 4.31:1 and text-warning 4.23:1, both under the 4.5:1 AA floor for 14px text. Use the -text variant (text-positive-text), or better, use <StatusBadge>, which carries the glyph as well.
Stock Tailwind shadow. Use shadow-raised, shadow-popover or shadow-overlay, which are defined per colour scheme — a black blur is invisible on a near-black ground.
